standard-dialogue-while-holding-the-seal.player: Can you tell me a bit about your people?
How about the values of the Moon clan!

standard-dialogue-while-holding-the-seal.npc: Let me see... We value knowledge of self because it is this that gives us our strength! It is most important!

standard-dialogue-while-holding-the-seal.player: Well... I know things about myself. I know I like hot chocolate!

standard-dialogue-while-holding-the-seal.npc: I was meaning something a little deeper than that. We also like to see someone listen. You know how they say a wise man listens?

standard-dialogue-without-the-seal-of-pa.npc: What are you doing here, Fremennik?!

standard-dialogue-without-the-seal-of-pa.player: I have a seal of pass...

standard-dialogue-without-the-seal-of-pa.text: The player is teleported to Rellekka.

standard-dialogue-without-the-seal-of-pa.player: Ooops. Suppose I need a seal of passage when I'm walking around that island.
